description: 한국서부발전(주)_전력 거래정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국서부발전(주). 한국서부발전의 분기별 전력판매 현황 정보 API 입니다. 분기별 전력거래량 및 거래금액 데이터는 전력시장에서 발생항 전력 거래 현황을 3개월 단위로 집계하여 제공하는 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국서부발전(주). Its tags are 발전, 전력, 거래, 전력 거래량, 전력 거래 금액. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
